title: Agent harness answers
description: The parameterization seam. Copy answers.example.json, fill it in, and pass it to bin/init.mjs with --answers. Every {{placeholder}} and conditional block in template/ resolves from these values. Unknown keys (such as $schema) are ignored. This schema is documentation + editor support only; init.mjs does not validate against it (it applies defaults for omitted fields).

$schema.description: Optional path to this schema, for editor validation/autocomplete.

harness_version.description: Version of the harness used when generating; informational only.

description.description: One sentence: what the repo is and the value it delivers.

task_runner.description: How verbs are invoked. 'direct' => skills call ./scripts/workon; 'just' emits a justfile; other runners emit a NOTICE to wire the verbs (the scaffolder never edits an existing manifest).

verify_cmd.description: The verification gate run before `done`, e.g. "make check" or "pnpm lint && pnpm test".

monorepo.description: true expands apps/ + packages/ layout prose in AGENTS.md; false collapses it.

name.description: The forge/tracker behind the verb contract. Only github is implemented today.

dependency_tracking.description: github: native "Blocked by" relations + the no-Prerequisites rule.

docs_audit.description: Install audit-docs (requires Node at use time) + its CI step.

enforcement.description: Compile policy into each target's native blocking mechanism.

areas.description: Generates docs/index.md entries; you write the content. e.g. ["architecture"].

policy.description: Command denials, compiled per target: cursor -> .cursor/hooks.json beforeShellExecution (failClosed); claude -> .claude/settings.json permissions.deny/ask; codex -> .codex/rules/harness.rules prefix_rule. Only command-level rules are enforceable.

decision.description: forbidden blocks the command; prompt asks for confirmation.
